inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL natural-language FULLTEXT query filters indexed text columns with MATCH ... AGAINST.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two independently authored matching notes and one unrelated note. MATCH ... AGAINST, stable ordering, and LIMIT isolate bounded full-text pagination.

fixture_notes: Two notes match and one does not; the bounded query returns both matching note IDs.
determinism_notes: Note IDs, text, search terms, ORDER BY, and LIMIT are fixed; the fixture has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE harbor_search_min (note_id INT PRIMARY KEY, note_title VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, note_body TEXT NOT NULL, FULLTEXT KEY ft_harbor_search_min (note_title, note_body)) ENGINE=InnoDB

INSERT INTO harbor_search_min VALUES (901, 'Beacon ledger', 'Harbor beacon marks the north channel.'), (902, 'Garden log', 'Copper labels mark seedlings behind the greenhouse.'), (903, 'Beacon repair', 'Harbor beacon needs a new lens.')

steps.sql: SELECT note_id, note_title FROM harbor_search_min WHERE MATCH(note_title, note_body) AGAINST ('harbor beacon') ORDER BY note_id LIMIT 2

checks.sql: SELECT note_id, note_title FROM harbor_search_min ORDER BY note_id
